svg.aria-label: Holographic SOC radar: five log sources, the Cisco network, OPNsense and Suricata, the Windows domain, Proxmox and Docker, and UniFi, feed a Wazuh core ringed by decode, correlate and respond stages, which forwards to Splunk. A brute force on DC-01 is detected, the rings turn red, a level 10 alert appears and the source is blocked.
svg.title: SOC radar
